mix_merge_rule: Every template implements ALL required sections and only vocabulary sections, with identical section names, identical element-key grammar, identical schema field names (per section type), and CSS-var-only styling. Therefore a section component is interchangeable between templates ONLY when both templates share the same family (style_tags[0]) — same design language + same contract = lossless swap. Cross-family swaps are forbidden (visual mismatch even though the schema fits).
